title: Source activity 1: Congruent figures
instruction: Figures with the same shape and size that can be superimposed exactly.

title: Source activity 2: SSS congruence
instruction: Three equal corresponding side lengths guarantee triangle congruence.

title: Source activity 3: SAS congruence
instruction: Two equal sides and the included angle guarantee congruence.

title: Source activity 4: SSA limitation
instruction: Two sides and a non-included angle do not guarantee congruence.
